title: Cranial vault and back-of-head shape under hair

queue.claim: ANSUR II / Farkas-type head priors: head length g–op ≈192–200 mm (M) / 182–190 (F), SD 6–7; head breadth eu–eu ≈150–157 / 143–149, SD 5–6; head circumference ≈565–580 / 545–560, SD ≈15; tragion–top of head ≈125–140 / 120–133
queue.query: ANSUR II headlength headbreadth headcircumference tragiontopofhead mean standard deviation male female

queue.claim: Within a population, face dimensions predict vault dimensions only weakly to moderately: bizygomatic width → head breadth r ≈0.4–0.6, face size → head length r ≈0.1–0.35; face shape after size removal explains R² ≈0.05–0.2 of vault shape
queue.query: correlation between bizygomatic breadth and head breadth head length living adults anthropometry

queue.claim: No open, commercially usable statistical cranium (vault) prior exists; LYHM, UHM and Headspace are academic, non-commercial; FLAME 2023 Open (CC BY 4.0) has a scalp but its training scans were not hair-controlled
queue.query: Liverpool-York Head Model LYHM Universal Head Model UHM download licence non-commercial 2026

queue.claim: Infant positional plagiocephaly/brachycephaly prevalence: Hutchison et al. 2004 NZ cohort 16% at 6 weeks, 19.7% at 4 months, 9.2% at 8 months, 6.8% at 12 months, 3.3% at 24 months; Mawji et al. 2013 Canada 46.6% at 7–12 weeks
queue.query: Hutchison 2004 Pediatrics plagiocephaly brachycephaly first two years prospective cohort prevalence 6 weeks 4 months 24 months

queue.claim: Scalp soft-tissue thickness over the vault ≈4–7 mm (vertex/parietal), 5–8 mm at opisthocranion, 6–10 mm at inion/nuchal; living head length exceeds skull length by ≈9–13 mm and breadth by ≈10–16 mm
queue.query: scalp soft tissue thickness vertex opisthocranion inion CT adults mm

queue.claim: Cephalic index population means: West African/African-American ≈72–78, NW European ≈75–80, Central European/Balkan ≈80–86, East Asian ≈80–88, within-population SD ≈3–4
queue.query: cephalic index adult population means comparison East Asian African European 3D head scans
